functions.purpose: Debug/telemetry serializer that dumps the full client<->server HIT/DAMAGE event structure field-by-field as labelled key/value lines via FUN_1024a290(printer,indent,ctx,label,fmtStr,value) and FUN_102713d0 (Vec3 dumper). Because it enumerates every field of the hit message with its exact name, offset and type, it is the authoritative field map for the GameOnHit / hit-report structure.
functions.serverRelevance: validation - this is the exact layout of the hit/damage event the client emits; the authoritative server must parse and validate these fields (attacker/firemode/attackName hashes, skill seq, defense result, hit index).
formulas: Vec3 fields are emitted as 3 consecutive floats each (11 vectors span this+0x28..this+0xa4).
llSkillSeq occupies two dwords this+0xfc (low) and this+0x100 (high), printed with %I64i.
Client-side srv-id fields (iShooterSrvId/iTargetSrvId/iWeaponSrvId/iProjectileSrvId) are the server-authoritative entity ids paired with the client dwShooterId/dwTargetId/etc.
functions.notes: No matching TLV struct found in TLV_DOCS/ for these field names (not one of the 12 catalogued combat TLVs); this is a raw in-memory event struct, likely the payload behind GameOnHit and the hit-report opcode. This layout should drive the server's hit-validation parser.

functions.purpose: Computes hit geometry for a melee/entity hit and dispatches a 'GameOnHit' script event (event 0x11f, flags 0x4ffff) to the target entity. Normalizes attack direction, rotates vectors by target orientation quaternion, derives a scar/impact rotation via acos+sin/cos, and packs a bounding region (500 units) + hash into the event table.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only - builds the client GameOnHit visual/scar event. The math is presentation (impact rotation), not damage; but it reads the same hit record and is the client emitter of GameOnHit.
constants: DAT_11de98a0 = tiny epsilon added to |v|^2 before rsqrt
DAT_11cbf070 = near-zero length threshold; DAT_11cbf074 = min-scale guard
formulas: impact angle theta = acos(dot(dir, refDir)); rotationVec = axis * cos(theta*0.5) style half-angle (fcos/fsin of dVar9*0.5)
region extents set to (500,500,500) around hit
functions.notes: Quaternion/half-angle rotation of the impact normal for decal/scar placement.

0x3dcccccd=0.1f and 0x3e4ccccd=0.2f passed to a draw call (line widths)

functions.purpose: BuffArea variant of the GameOnHit builder: resolves source (param_1+0x44) and target (param_2+8) entities, computes normalized direction between them, derives impact rotation (same acos+half-angle math as FUN_10b255c0), and dispatches 'GameOnHit' (via vtbl+0x144 -> +0x24) to the target with a 'BuffArea' event-name hash.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only - buff-area hit visual/GameOnHit emission. Confirms buff areas route through the same GameOnHit path with a BuffArea tag.
constants: same as FUN_10b255c0: rsqrt 1.5/0.5, sign mask DAT_11de9c90, region 500.0f
event name hashes via FUN_10b27fd0("BuffArea") and FUN_10b27fd0(param_3)
formulas: dir = normalize(targetPos - sourcePos); impact rotation = half-angle(cos/sin) of acos(dot)

functions.purpose: NPC/entity OnHit processing: resolves attacker (param_2[0]) and validates target alive (health via vtbl+0x304 > 0) and not blocking (attacker vtbl+0x1a4). If valid: records hit, fires 'OnHit' FSM event (code 4), notifies all registered hit-listeners (array param_1+0x25c..+0x260), and sends impact/decal events (types 0x17/0x18/0x19) carrying the damage value param_2[0x11] to the render/effect layer (param_1+0x40 vtbl+0x18).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only - client OnHit reaction, listener fan-out and decal events. Confirms damage/value carried at hit record +0x44 (param_2[0x11]) and health gate, but the authoritative kill/damage decision is elsewhere.
constants: DAT_11de9890 = min value threshold for decal/impact (param_2[0x11] must exceed)
protocolFields: param_2[0]=target/self id, param_2[1]=attacker id, param_2[2]=weapon/proj id

functions.purpose: Melee/area attack resolver: runs a physics/proximity query (vtbl+0x288) around the attacker producing up to 100 candidate part-entities (results in local_384[], ids in local_514[]); for each candidate it enforces a per-target hit-count cap (param_1[0xa]) and, when allowed, computes the normalized hit direction (attacker pos param_1[4..6] minus target center) and dispatches a 'GameOnHit' script event (event 0x4ffff via vtbl+0x144 -> +0x24) to that target, tagging self-hit (isSelf = queried root id == hit id).
functions.serverRelevance: validation - this is the CLIENT melee hit-detection geometry: radius/range query + per-target multi-hit cap. An authoritative server must reproduce the same proximity test (center param_1[4..6], radius param_1[7]) and per-target hit cap (param_1[0xa]) to validate claimed hits.
constants: DAT_11de9890 = min radius/value gate on param_1[7]
rsqrt normalize constants 1.5f/0.5f, sign mask DAT_11de9c90
protocolFields: param_1[0]=attackerRootId, param_1[1]=?, param_1[4..6]=attack center Vec3, param_1[7]=radius/range
param_1[0xa]=max hits per target (hit-count cap), param_1[0xb]=result capacity(100), param_1[0xc]=results ptr, param_1[0xd]=id-out ptr, param_1[0xe]=event/attack hash
formulas: for each hit part: dir = normalize(center - partCenter) with rsqrt (1.5-0.5*|v|^2*x*x)*x; if !multiHit or hitCount<cap emit GameOnHit
functions.notes: This function is the closest thing in this chunk to authoritative client hit-detection; pairs with FUN_102d9480's hit record. Verify radius/cap semantics against server design.
